title: The Day We Met
caption: The day we  met, after all those conversations. Seeing you in front of me felt different in the best possible way.

title: Finally Together
caption: We had started getting to love each other, but being together already felt so easy and natural. Love youuu

title: Comfort Came Naturally
caption: Somehow, being around you didn't feel new for long. I felt comfortable, safe, and completely myself with you.

title: Just Us
caption: Nothing complicated, nothing forced… just two people enjoying being together and slowly becoming something more.

title: A Moment I Want To Replay
caption: I wish I could go back to this moment sometimes. The laughter, the happiness, and simply having you beside me.

title: Happiness With You
caption: It's amazing how quickly someone can become a reason for your happiness. Being with you just felt good.

title: Safe With You
caption: One of the most beautiful things about us is how safe and comfortable we already feel around each other.

title: A Day To Remember
caption: It was only one day together, but somehow it gave us so many little moments that I already want to remember forever.

title: Just The Beginning
caption: This is only the beginning of our story. We've just started, yet I'm already excited for all the moments, memories, love, and happiness waiting for us.
